citations.quote: Congresswoman Susie Lee (NV-03) announced she has received the endorsements of EMILYs List, Planned Parenthood Action Fund, Reproductive Freedom for All, and National Organization for Women (NOW) PAC.
EMILYs List is proud to endorse Rep. Susie Lee for reelection.
citations.locator: statement of Jessica Mackler, EMILYs List President
